input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Tesla's net income attributable to common stockholders for Q3 2026 was higher than Q3 2025. The evidence clearly contradicts this claim.

Evidence E7 and E8 are XBRL facts with EXACT_MATCH period compatibility showing Q3 2026 net income attributable to common stockholders was $787 million compared to $1,373 million in Q3 2025. Evidence E9 is a derived metric with COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION status confirming the same figures and showing a year-over-year decline of 42.68%.

All three challenge hypotheses were investigated:
H1 (restatement): No evidence found of any restatement or correction to the Q3 2025 figures.
H2 (non-GAAP adjustments): No evidence found of alternative presentations showing Q3 2026 higher than Q3 2025.
H3 (preliminary figures): No evidence found suggesting the Q3 2026 figure is preliminary or subject to revision.

The evidence review confirms that E7, E8, and E9 are VALID evidence with appropriate period compatibility (EXACT_MATCH or COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION) and HISTORICAL_FACT statement time. These evidence items CONTRADICT the claim.

The verdict remains CONTRADICTED because the evidence definitively shows Q3 2026 net income ($787 million) was lower, not higher, than Q3 2025 ($1,373 million).
